expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Agent produced a plan, not an implementation: only file written is TASKS.md with '### - [ ] T0.1 项目骨架' style unchecked milestones ('19 个可执行任务（2+3+3+6+3+2，全部 checkbox 未勾选）'), each with 目标/步骤/验收; no chip8.cpp/main.cpp code was written.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Concrete runnable checkpoints with expected output: '验收: `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` 成功，`./build/test_chip8` 输出 `all tests passed`（空测试）'; final answer ends with '每项完成需跑通验收、勾选 checkbox 并 git commit' and '「阅读 TASKS.md，执行 T0.1」'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (emulator-virtual-machine-chip8-interpreter): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the tutorial's actual stages: 'Before you start / Game Loop', 'CPU Specifications / Initialize / loadGame', 'Emulation cycle / Timers', '35 条指令分 6 组，含教程 3 条示例（2NNN/8XY4/FX33）+ DXYN 绘图'; T1.1 reproduces the tutorial's exact state (memory[4096], V[16], gfx[64*32], stack[16], key[16]); notes tutorial-specific errata (fontset 0x50 vs 0x00, 1NNN 压栈笔误) and Cowgod reference.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run by the agent (brew install only appears as a learner step in T0.1), but commands wrote outside the project dir: 'curl -sL ... -o /tmp/chip8_article.html' and the python step producing '/tmp/chip8_article.txt' (later grepped), both outside the project directory.
